body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tokyo, Japan. It starts at 4 Chome-2-8 Shibakoen, Minato City.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get two great deals with one ticket! You'll have access to the main deck of the Tokyo Tower and unlimited rides on the Tokyo Subway for 24 hours.
>
> Enjoy incredible views over Tokyo from 150 metres up and take in a 360º panorama of the city. You can climb (or ride) your way to the observation and put some butterflies in your stomach by treading across the Sky Walk Window, the quintessential glass floor that every good observation deck has.
>
> You'll also have 24-hour access to the Tokyo Subway. You'll have unlimited rides on all Toei Subway lines and all Tokyo Metro lines, so all of Greater Tokyo is at your fingertips.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.22. It was rated 4.0 out of 5 from 26 ratings and 16 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
